name: Examorelin
aliases: Hexarelin, EP 23905, EP-23905, EP23905, Exarelin, Hexamorelin, MF 6003, MF-6003
summary: Examorelin is a potent, synthetic, peptidic, orally-active, centrally-penetrant, and highly selective agonist of the ghrelin/growth hormone secretagogue receptor (GHSR) and a growth hormone secretagogue which was developed by Mediolanum Farmaceutici. It is a hexapeptide with the amino acid sequence His-D-2-methyl-Trp-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2 which was derived from GHRP-6.

pharmacology.text: Examorelin (INN; also known as hexarelin; developmental codes EP-23905 and MF-6003) is a potent, synthetic, peptidic, orally-active, centrally-penetrant, and highly selective agonist of the ghrelin/growth hormone secretagogue receptor (GHSR) and a growth hormone secretagogue which was developed by Mediolanum Farmaceutici.

uses.text: Examorelin (INN; also known as hexarelin; developmental codes EP-23905 and MF-6003) is a potent, synthetic, peptidic, orally-active, centrally-penetrant, and highly selective agonist of the ghrelin/growth hormone secretagogue receptor (GHSR) and a growth hormone secretagogue which was developed by Mediolanum Farmaceutici. Pre-treatment with IGF-1 also blunts the GH-elevating effect of examorelin.
